items.name: threshold-globe
items.title: Threshold Globe
items.description: A rotating dot-globe reverse-engineered from Cloudflare's login-page background: a real orthographic projection of world land, dithered into a shimmering grid.

items.name: wave-field
items.title: Wave Field
items.description: A grid of cells that pulse as a deterministic traveling wave sweeps across them — direction, easing and bounce are all configurable, and the underlying wave function is framework-agnostic.
